title: Xanthe and the Radiators
author: D. M. Quintana
blurb: Tamsin Oyelaran, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
